description: Create, update or return Box infrastructure (connect / Linux / Windows / Tensorflow servers, NAS, Hadoop clusters). Each list item carries an actionType. Use dryRun=true to preview.

boxNasList.description: NAS changes (at least 1 NAS must remain)

count.description: Number of NAS volumes (required for CREATE)

nasSize.description: NAS volume size in GB (500-10000, 100 GB steps)

blockStorageInstanceNo.description: Connect server block storage instance number (required for UPDATE / DELETE)

serverInstanceNo.description: Connect server instance number (required for UPDATE / DELETE)

specCode.description: Connect server spec code (required for CREATE / UPDATE)

storageSize.description: Block storage size in GB (10-2000, 10 GB steps; required for CREATE / UPDATE)

userPassword1.description: ncp1 account password — 8-14 chars with at least one upper, lower, digit and special char (', ", `, ₩, /, &, $, space not allowed)

userPassword2.description: ncp2 account password — 8-14 chars with at least one upper, lower, digit and special char (', ", `, ₩, /, &, $, space not allowed)

dryRun.description: If true, returns the request without sending it

edgeNodeSpecCode.description: Edge node spec code (required for CREATE / UPDATE)

hadoopClusterNo.description: Hadoop cluster number — instanceNo of the HD infra in ncloud_datafence_list_box_infra (required for UPDATE / DELETE)

masterNodeSpecCode.description: Master node spec code (required for CREATE / UPDATE)

masterNodeStorageSize.description: Master node block storage in GB (required for CREATE; 100-2000 in 10 GB steps, 4000/6000 also allowed)

userPassword.description: Hadoop cluster account password — 8-14 chars with at least one upper, lower, digit and special char (', ", `, ₩, /, &, $, space not allowed)

workerNodeCount.description: Number of worker nodes (required for CREATE / UPDATE)

workerNodeSpecCode.description: Worker node spec code (required for CREATE / UPDATE)

workerNodeStorageSize.description: Worker node block storage in GB (required for CREATE)

blockStorageInstanceNo.description: Linux server block storage instance number (required for UPDATE / DELETE)

serverInstanceNo.description: Linux server instance number (required for UPDATE / DELETE)

softwareCode.description: Linux server software code (required for CREATE / UPDATE)

specCode.description: Linux server spec code (required for CREATE / UPDATE)
